_comment: Per-language SEA-HELM aggregate scores (canonical, from SEA-HELM's own aggregate_metrics). base.jv and base.su are null because this SEA-HELM snapshot does not include jv/su tasks (it covers id, vi, ms, my, ta, th, tl only). The capability_no_regression gate for jv and su is therefore INCONCLUSIVE:SEA-HELM-cannot-measure-this. SEA-HELM's final aggregate_metrics() crashed at PRAGMATICS (id_linguistic-diagnostics) with KeyError 'subcategories' (upstream bug, see logs/DEVIATIONS.md 2026-10-03). Only the first four competencies completed for id before the crash: nlu=0.0 (failed tasks), safety=34.002 (3/4 safeguard tasks completed), nlg=0.0 (translation tasks failed - no MetricX), nlr=0.0 (causal failed). linguistic-diagnostics, instruction-following, multi-turn, cultural, knowledge did not aggregate because of the crash. base_per_task_id gives the per-task accuracies recovered from the per-task results JSON for transparency. base_tasks and tuned_tasks list the four id tasks that completed and will be matched exactly for the tuned run (rule 7).
